VTP.Title: VTools Tension Pool
VTP.Settings.PoolSize.Name: Pool Size
VTP.Settings.PoolSize.Hint: Maximum number of dice in the tension pool.
VTP.Settings.IconTheme.Name: Icon Theme
VTP.Settings.IconTheme.Hint: Choose the icon style for the tension pool.
VTP.Settings.DiceSize.Name: Dice Size
VTP.Settings.DiceSize.Hint: Type of dice to roll in the tension pool. Refresh required after changing.
VTP.Settings.ComplicationMacro.Name: Complication Macro
VTP.Settings.ComplicationMacro.Hint: Comma-separated names of macros to execute when a complication is rolled. Leave blank to disable.
VTP.CustomRoll.Title: Custom Tension Roll
VTP.CustomRoll.Label: Number of dice to roll (max 50)
VTP.BulkAdd.Title: Bulk Add Dice
VTP.BulkAdd.Label: Number of dice to add (max 50)
VTP.Settings.SoundEnabled.Name: Enable Sounds
VTP.Settings.SoundEnabled.Hint: Play sound effects for tension pool events.
VTP.Settings.AddDieSound.Name: Add Die Sound
VTP.Settings.AddDieSound.Hint: Sound effect when a die is added to the pool. Use a file path or leave default.
VTP.Settings.RemoveDieSound.Name: Remove Die Sound
VTP.Settings.RemoveDieSound.Hint: Sound effect when a die is removed from the pool.
VTP.Settings.RollSound.Name: Roll Sound
VTP.Settings.RollSound.Hint: Sound effect when the tension pool is rolled.
VTP.Disclaimer.Title: VTools Tension Pool — AI-Generated Code Disclosure
VTP.Disclaimer.Content:
VTools Tension Pool contains AI-generated code. The author personally understands and maintains all code. You can review the source code at github.com/WesleySniperss/vtools-tension-pool.

By clicking Accept, you consent to running this module. You may disable it at any time from the Module Management menu.
VTP.Disclaimer.Disabled: VTools Tension Pool is disabled until a GM accepts the AI-generated code disclaimer.
VTP.Disclaimer.DisablePrompt.Title: Disable Module?
VTP.Disclaimer.DisablePrompt.Content: Would you like to disable VTools Tension Pool? You can re-enable it from Game Settings → Manage Modules.
VTP.RollHidden: The dice have spoken... what fate awaits?
VTP.GMOnly: Only a Gamemaster can change the Tension Pool.
VTP.Settings.RollVisibility.Name: Roll Visibility
VTP.Settings.RollVisibility.Hint: Choose whether tension pool rolls and announcements are visible to all players or only to GMs.
VTP.Settings.ExampleMacros.Name: Install Example Macros
VTP.Settings.ExampleMacros.Hint: Create a folder of example macros demonstrating the Tension Pool API. These macros are managed by the module — any edits will be lost when the setting is toggled.
